title: H1: credential identity is the user URI
description: protocol-06 §3 Table 1 vs §7.5: no rule maps an MLS credential to a participant-list user. Readings: (a) BasicCredential identity = user URI (mimi://b.example/u/bob), shared by all the user's clients; (b) client URI plus a client->user mapping. Chosen by Mark 2026-10-18: (a). Stateless and matches §7.5; affects .12 and .13. wg item to file.
notes: 2026-10-18 (Mark): keep H1 and document the interop limit found by S10: stock mls-rs BasicIdentityProvider rejects two leaves with the same BasicCredential (DuplicateLeafData), so under H1 a multi-device user cannot share a group with stock mls-rs clients. See wg mimid-1wgh.37.67.
